Let the vectors form a triangle with vertices \(O\), \(A\), and \(B\), where

\[
\overrightarrow{OA}=\mathbf a,\qquad \overrightarrow{OB}=\mathbf b,\qquad \overrightarrow{BA}=\mathbf a-\mathbf b.
\]

The angle between \(\mathbf a\) and \(\mathbf b\) is the angle at \(O\):

\[
\angle AOB=29^\circ.
\]

The angle between \(\mathbf b=\overrightarrow{OB}\) and \(\mathbf a-\mathbf b=\overrightarrow{BA}\) is \(84^\circ\). But the interior angle at \(B\) is between \(\overrightarrow{BO}=-\mathbf b\) and \(\overrightarrow{BA}=\mathbf a-\mathbf b\), so

\[
\angle OBA=180^\circ-84^\circ=96^\circ.
\]

Thus the third angle is

\[
\angle OAB=180^\circ-29^\circ-96^\circ=55^\circ.
\]

The angle between \(\mathbf a=\overrightarrow{OA}\) and \(\mathbf a-\mathbf b=\overrightarrow{BA}\) is the same as the angle between \(\overrightarrow{AO}\) and \(\overrightarrow{AB}\), which is \(\angle OAB\). Therefore, the desired angle is

\[
\boxed{55^\circ}.
\]
